results.title: Microcredit association chair blames weak lender risk assessment for loan defaults
results.content: The National Board Chairperson of the Micro Credit Association Ghana, Benjamin Turkson Junior, has attributed loan defaults in parts of the microcredit sector to weak risk management systems among some lending institutions. He has urged financial institutions to strengthen their assessment of prospective borrowers and establish effective mechanisms to evaluate their creditworthiness before approving loans. Speaking in an interview at the Association’s Annual General Meeting in Ho, Mr Turkson argued that lenders must take greater responsibility for ensuring that loans are advanced to customers with the capacity and willingness to repay. “I have always personally developed a philosophy where I say we don’t have bad borrowers, but we have bad lenders,” he said.

results.title: JUSAG to begin strike November 2 over unpaid salary arrears
results.content: The Judicial Service Staff Association of Ghana (JUSAG) has declared an indefinite strike from Monday, November 2, 2026, following the government’s failure to approve its members’ 2026 salary review.

results.title: YPYC Foundation announces nominees for 17th Africa Role Model Awards
results.content: The Young Professionals and Youth Coalition (YPYC) Foundation has announced its shortlist for the 17th Africa Role Model Awards, with several prominent personalities from Ghana and other African countries nominated for recognition. The winners will be announced at the 17th Transform Summit and Africa Role Model Awards ceremony scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026, at the ISSER Conference Hall of the University of Ghana, Legon. The event, which begins at 12:00 noon, will be held under the theme, “Leadership in Action: Breaking Barriers and Building Success.” Chief of Staff, Dr Julius Debrah, is expected to attend as the Special Guest of Honour. The awards seek to recognise individuals whose contributions have made an impact in areas including traditional leadership, academia, religion, business, media, engineering, politics, education, law, energy and philanthropy.
